data.description:
# Spring into Action with STILT!

Play as Liam Fuzz, a space postmaster on a quest to reclaim stolen cargo on a vibrant alien planet. Armed with springy STILTs, bounce through 20 exciting levels in a colorful, quirky VR adventure!

{1106170781213845}

# Breathtaking VR Platforming

Leap over cliffs, dodge traps, and explore dazzling landscapes. Use your reflexes and problem-solving skills to overcome icy peaks, fiery volcanoes, and treacherous terrains.

# Epic Power-Ups

{563365949630419}

Upgrade your STILTs to glide, blast fireballs, and tackle tougher challenges. Every power-up brings new ways to dominate the levels with style.

# Multiplayer Chaos

{2069239766881620}

Compete with friends in high-energy arenas! Battle it out in modes like Smack-em-all! and Balloon Hunt to see who’s the ultimate stilt master.

# Get Ready to STILT!

Reclaim your cargo, outsmart a mischievous octopus, and bounce into an unforgettable VR adventure.

# Join the STILT Community

{544687088548166}

Connect with players and stay updated on all things STILT: https://discord.gg/mYy9Z8axEm

changelog.change_log:
[Christmas] Introduced a new multiplayer event: Winterland Rescue, replacing Hops of Horror. Assist a rabbit in delivering a star to the Christmas tree while defending it from attacking snowmen by shooting them down.
[Christmas] Added 9 new Christmas-themed cosmetics to unlock.
[Christmas] Transformed the lobby with winter decorations.
[Christmas] Added a snow effect to the main menu for a seasonal touch.
[New Feature] Added a "Meet-Up Timer" to the lobby, designed to help players coordinate and find each other more easily. Let us know if this feature makes finding people smoother!
[Improvement] Improved player position synchronization over the network to reduce bandwidth usage and deliver smoother movement.
[Improvement] Updated the hookshot power-up visuals to use the new synchronization method for improved smoothness.
[Fix] Resolved an issue where the underlying time system would lag behind and "catch up" for a few seconds after connecting to a server.

[Fix] Fixed out-of-sync lookup table for spawnable objects, causing incorrect objects to spawn in certain actions, leading to errors, crashes, and unintended behavior.
[Fix] Addressed an issue where a microphone could be requested despite none being available.

[Improvement] The intro logo section at startup is now skippable.
[Improvement] Lip-syncing is now visible in mirrors for preview.
[Fix] Resolved blend shape normal issues on the three new Halloween skins.
[Fix] Fixed various minor issues to enhance overall stability.
[Other] Internal upgrades for crash reporting and debugging.

[Halloween] A new multiplayer area is now accessible from the lobby! Step into a hauntingly atmospheric setting filled with jump scares and spine-tingling ambiance as you hunt for crystals and perform a ritual to unlock exclusive free cosmetics.
[Halloween] The multiplayer lobby has received a spooky Halloween-themed makeover.
[New Feature] Added three new Halloween-inspired skins and four new cosmetic items.
[Improvement] Enhanced textures for stone bricks, cliff stones, wood planks, and dirt.
[Improvement] Upgraded the fog effect for improved quality, with a refined method for fading below levels.

[New Feature] Added a new multiplayer game mode, Color Splash! Jump around and paint everything in sight. The player who covers the most area before time runs out wins!
[Improvement] Added a progress counter above doors that open only after enemies are defeated, providing clearer feedback on progress.
[Improvement] Made the first exit in Level 19 - Lava Mystery easier to locate.
[Improvement] Adjusted the starting positions of rising platforms in the boss battle to guide players more effectively.
[Improvement] Reduced how much the game over and score screens are head-locked, improving overall comfort.
[Improvement] Added a tip suggesting assist mode activation if the player has died multiple times.
[Improvement] Changed the audio effects for level portals in the overworld and adjusted transitions to fade to black instead of white.
[Improvement] Added walls around the arena in Floor Pop game mode to prevent early punch outs.
[Fix] Resolved an issue where players could get stuck inside locked doors.
[Fix] Fixed icon alignment on level portals—stamp rewards are now properly displayed on the left side with the rest of the stamp information.
[Fix] Corrected an issue where buttons meant to be pressed once could be activated multiple times.
[Fix] Portals in levels and gameplay are now triggered only by the player’s head, not the stilts.
[Fix] Resolved a bug where the sliding puzzle cube could clip into walls.
[Fix] Fixed issues with cloud platforms in Level - Windmill Hills.
[Fix] Addressed a bug where the game could appear frozen due to pausing during a loading screen.
[Fix] Fixed an issue where looping audio persisted between scenes if the game was paused during a scene transition.

[Improvement] Enabled the ability to reconnect to a multiplayer game after disconnection.
[Improvement] Ensured the menu consistently faces the player after resetting the VR space in the main menu.
[Improvement] Made the pause menu accessible during the intro sequence.
[Improvement] Added a notification when entering multiplayer mode without a network connection.
[Other] Extended the AFK timer in multiplayer from 60 seconds to 90 seconds.

[New Feature] Added Assist Mode, offering a set of customizable settings to enhance your gameplay experience:
- Unlimited Respawns: Respawn without the need for stamps.
- Add Assist Elements: Adds extra platforms to make difficult sections easier and provides hints for mandatory puzzles.
- Highlight Pickup Items: Beams of light will highlight every gift and key, making them easier to find.
- Timeless Challenges: Removes timers from all time-based challenges.
- Power-Up Shield: Prevents loss of power-ups when taking damage.
- Game Over Shop: Choose any power-up from the shop when you die, instead of receiving a random one.
[New Feature] Added a shooting challenge to the lobby. Shoot all targets and compete for the best time.
[New Feature] Added musical instruments to the lobby for players to interact with.
[New Feature] Added a rabbit character that hides somewhere in the lobby. Find it, and it will hide again.
[Fix] Resolved white noise flickering on edges.
[Improvement] Redesigned the game over screen button layout for better clarity and usability.
[Other] Changed the random power-up selection on the game over screen to occur after purchase instead of before.
[Improvement] Enhanced the random selection process for game sets in the multiplayer arena to ensure a more even distribution of game modes. It now selects three different random game modes first and then chooses random levels that correspond to each mode.
[Improvement] Minor performance optimization's.
[Improvement] Added a dynamic refresh rate feature that allows the game to step down from 90Hz to 72Hz in demanding situations, ensuring a stable framerate.

[New Feature] Added ability to dress up the player with different cosmetic options.
[New Feature] Added 20 findable cosmetics, one hidden in each level.
[New Feature] Players' mouths now move to match your voice in multiplayer.
[Improvement] Enhanced in-game UI interaction: you can now point and shoot at buttons within a certain area, in addition to physically clicking them.
[Improvement] Rearranged the main menu buttons to reduce clutter.

[Improvement] Added a new option to completely disable joystick turning for players.
[New Feature] Introducing "Floor Pop" arena game mode where players must outlast others by navigating disappearing platforms.
[Fix] Addressed several minor visual bugs.
[Fix] Resolved an issue that prevented players from entering the arena in private lobbies with more than four participants.
[Other] Internal improvements.

- [New Feature] Players can now choose their server region, either in the settings menu or within the group up room, providing greater control over matchmaking and connectivity.
- [New Feature] Introducing a new multiplayer level: Split Valley Woods. Explore this exciting new environment with friends in multiplayer mode.
- [Fix] Addressed minor level issues and implemented internal system enhancements for improved gameplay stability.
- [Fix] Corrected an issue where appear spikes causing damage did not align correctly with visual cues before initial strike.
- [Fix] Resolved an exploit where players could become invulnerable by pausing the game immediately after taking damage.
- [Fix] Resolved an issue where pausing during fog transitions into arena gameplay could cause the transition to become stuck.
- [Potential Fix] Investigated and addressed reports of players falling through the floor upon respawning at the boss level. Further testing is ongoing to confirm the effectiveness of the solution.

- [Improvement] Reimagined the visual effect when players are within bushes or trees. Instead of completely obstructing vision, the effect now conceals the object while displaying a transparent overlay, accompanied by a particle effect of leaves.
- [Improvement] Implemented controller vibration feedback for power-up activations.
- [New Feature] Introduced an option to restart a level directly from the pause menu.
- [Fix] Fixed issue where achievement "Don't look down" was not triggered.
